import re

def extract_artists_from_text(txt):
    if not txt:
        return []
    # Match phrases like: "Here are some of my favorites artists, Felix Blackwood, Dylan Stone"
    patterns=[
        r"favorite\s+artists\s*,\s*([A-Za-z0-9][^\n\r]*)",
        r"favorites\s+artists\s*,\s*([A-Za-z0-9][^\n\r]*)",
        r"favorite\s+artists\s*[:\-]\s*([A-Za-z0-9][^\n\r]*)",
        r"favorites\s+artists\s*[:\-]\s*([A-Za-z0-9][^\n\r]*)",
    ]
    for pat in patterns:
        m=re.search(pat, txt, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if m:
            # split by comma and strip
            names=[x.strip() for x in m.group(1).split(',') if x.strip()]
            return names
    return []
